name: arith_mersenne_prime_factor
informal: Prime factors q of 2^p - 1 (p odd prime) satisfy q ≡ 1 mod 2p and q ≡ ±1 mod 8 — the order of 2 mod q is p so p | q-1, q odd gives 2p | q-1; 2 = (2^((p+1)/2))² mod q is a square, so q ≡ ±1 mod 8.
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ≠ 2 → Nat.Prime q → q ∣ 2 ^ p - 1 → q % (2 * p) = 1 ∧ (q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 7)
